title: 2023 Singapore GP, lap 20: safety car with one dry compound used
question: Safety car deployed on lap 20. Norris is P4 on 19-lap-old mediums and has used only the medium so far. Do we box?

title: 2023 Singapore GP, lap 44: VSC, Hamilton on 23-lap-old hards
question: VSC deployed on lap 44 with 18 laps to go. Hamilton is P4 on 23-lap-old hards, 0.5 s behind Norris. He has used mediums and hards. New mediums and softs are available.

title: 2023 Singapore GP, lap 44: VSC, Sainz leading on 23-lap-old hards
question: VSC deployed on lap 44 with 18 laps to go. Sainz leads on 23-lap-old hards with the cars behind within a few seconds. Singapore is a street circuit where overtaking is difficult.

title: 2024 British GP, lap 27: rain on 26-lap-old mediums
question: Rain is falling. Hamilton is P3 on 26-lap-old mediums, the only compound he has used; his last two laps were 95.0 s and 100.8 s against 91 s in the dry.

title: 2024 British GP, lap 38: drying track on intermediates
question: Hamilton is P2 on 10-lap-old intermediates, 2.0 s behind Norris (also on intermediates). His lap times have fallen from 102.8 s to 99.7 s over four laps and one car has already switched to slicks.

title: 2024 Sao Paulo GP, lap 32: red flag, Verstappen yet to stop
question: The race is suspended. Verstappen is P2 on 31-lap-old intermediates and has not pitted. Teams may work on the cars in the pit lane during the suspension.

title: 2024 Sao Paulo GP, lap 28: VSC on worn intermediates
question: VSC deployed on lap 28. Norris is P2, 0.4 s behind Russell, on intermediates aged 31 laps; his lap times rose from 84.0 s to 86.9 s over the last four green laps.

title: Dry race, lap 32/53: medium-only car tempted by new mediums
question: Leclerc started on mediums and has not stopped. New mediums would be the fastest tyre for the last 21 laps. What do we fit?

title: Dry race, lap 49/53: hard-only car with four laps left
question: Albon started on hards and has not stopped; he is P7 with four laps to go after this one. Can we bring it home without stopping?

title: Lap 28/57: undercut attempt with a 5 s penalty pending
question: Russell is P4, 1.6 s behind Hamilton, whose mediums are degrading 120 ms/lap. We want to undercut. Russell has a 5 s time penalty pending.

title: Lap 35/58: 10 s penalty and a mandatory stop still to make
question: Alonso is P6 on 34-lap-old hards (he started on hards) with a 10 s penalty pending. He still has to stop. What is the stop and what does it cost?

title: Lap 30/58: VSC five laps before the planned stop
question: VSC just deployed. Piastri is P3 on 22-lap-old mediums (mediums only so far) and was due to stop on lap 35.

title: Lap 25/57: safety car with the pit entry closed
question: Safety car just deployed for a crash at the pit entry, which is closed. Norris is P2 on 20-lap-old mediums (mediums only so far).

title: Lap 15/52: heavy rain on softs
question: Rain is intensifying. Sainz is P4 on 14-lap-old softs and losing several seconds a lap. Intermediates and wets are available.

title: Lap 40/52: dry line on 12-lap-old intermediates
question: The track has dried. Russell is P3 on 12-lap-old intermediates that are overheating; cars on slicks are lapping faster.

title: Lap 22/57: a stop now rejoins in a four-car DRS train
question: Leclerc is P3 on 21-lap-old mediums (mediums only so far). A green stop now rejoins him behind a train of four cars running within a second of each other, all due to stop within three laps.

title: Lap 18/57: undercut on a rival with fading mediums
question: Hamilton is P4, 1.4 s behind Russell, whose mediums are degrading 140 ms/lap. There is 25 s of clear air behind.

title: Lap 49/57: late safety car, both compounds already used
question: Late safety car. Verstappen is P2 on 30-lap-old hards and has used mediums and hards; the car behind is 16 s back. The leader is staying out on 36-lap-old hards.

title: Lap 20/57: red flag before the first stop
question: The race is red-flagged on lap 20. Piastri is P3 on 19-lap-old mediums and has not stopped. Teams may change tyres during the suspension.

title: Lap 50/57: both compounds used, gap behind smaller than a stop
question: Gasly is P8 on 22-lap-old hards (mediums used earlier), degrading slowly. P9 is 8 s behind. Is a stop for softs worth it?
